criteria.channels: Exact RGBA pixel differences at native resolution
criteria.mouthOnly: Compare each mouth against neutral with exactly the same eyelid and gaze inputs; zero changed pixels outside the current mouth destination
criteria.clip: Zero changed pixels outside the current clip polygon, allowing one source pixel for clip antialiasing; destination remains a strict boundary
criteria.protection: Zero changed pixels in independently registered eyes, brows, nose, chin and any additional protection polygons
criteria.legacy: Neutral/openSmall/openWide must reproduce the approved pitchGaze version exactly with matching eyelid and gaze inputs
criteria.original: Original mode must equal the approved original regardless of mouth, eyelid or gaze targets
criteria.repeatability: Three identical renders per probe before and after each pose suite, plus before/after equality; all pixel differences must be exactly zero

Shared source identity is reported explicitly. The private temporary iris core canvas is not retained by the renderer.
